author: BernieSanders
text:
Trump’s racist and lying tirade against Angie Nixon tells you one thing. They're EXTREMELY worried she’s going to win.

And they should be scared because, with your help, she WILL win.

I look forward to campaigning with Angie and our friends in Florida in the very near future.
